metadata.description: Stability tests of the Lustre 2.17.0 cluster (RDMA/o2ib, FLR), 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-08. Source of truth: UJEP-LAB/benchmarks/stability; tooling UJEP-LAB/tools/stability.py; regenerate with tools/make_stability_data.py.
metadata.cluster: 10 nodes: 2 heads (MGS+MDT0 on Head-1, MDT1 on Head-2) + 8 computes (16 OSTs)
metadata.units: seconds unless noted; cold-boot times relative to the first IPMI power-on command

scripts.legacy: lustre-startup with iteration-counted timeouts: real MGS wait limit about 145-170 s, LNET wait about 11 s, no retry
scripts.fixed: lustre-startup with $SECONDS deadlines (MGS 600 s, LNET 120 s) and Restart=on-failure

caveats: Small number of runs per condition; not statistics.
Per-node times use node clocks corrected against the controller (+-1-2 s).
Restart=on-failure retry path was not exercised.
Hard power-off cold boots are not representative of production (two power lines, 2 UPS each, scheduled shutdowns).
Node-loss and readfail runs used 256 MB dd files pinned with lfs mirror create; the hung operations are as long as the outage, which differs between runs (see per-run outage_s / t_back - t_kill).

soak.description: 6 h soak 2026-10-15: mixed 70/30 random fio, 1 MiB direct, iodepth 8, 2 jobs, 2 GiB files per node, 5 min fio per round on all 8 computes
soak.unit_note: MiB/s as recorded; Gbit/s = MiB/s x 8.388608 / 1000

findings.title: Legacy startup script times out early
findings.result: MGS wait limit is about 145-170 s instead of 300 s (loop counts iterations, not seconds); LNET wait about 11 s instead of 60 s.

findings.title: Head-1 (MGS) is always the last node up
findings.result: Reaches the OS about 190 s after its own power-on versus about 90 s for other blades.

findings.title: Startup fix verified
findings.result: With wall-clock deadlines computes waited up to 344 s for the MGS (Head-1 held 240 s) and all 10 nodes mounted with 0 fatal retries.

findings.title: Data integrity across unclean power-off
findings.result: 40/40 files sha256-identical after each of 2 hard power-offs of all 10 nodes.

findings.title: OST recovery window after unclean stop
findings.result: After a hard stop of all nodes only 2 of 16 OSTs were visible for another 275-292 s (5:00 recovery window; MDT with abort_recov is denied as new client). Graceful shutdown: pool complete immediately. Accepted (scheduled shutdowns).

findings.title: Kernel update would break the boot
findings.result: dnf update installed Rocky 9.8 kernel on Compute-2, UPDATEDEFAULT=yes made it the default; no Lustre modules on boot. Fixed: kernel* excluded, UPDATEDEFAULT=no.

findings.title: FLR is delayed mirroring
findings.result: Writes land on one mirror; the other stays stale until lfs mirror resync (stale=12/12 and 20/20 right after writing). Without resync, data on a lost node is unavailable until it returns.

findings.title: Reads fail over automatically when mirrors are in sync
findings.result: Node loss with resynced mirrors: 246-292 reads ok during a 240 s outage, longest stall 3-41 s, 0 failures after return.

findings.title: Writes and creates block on a dead OSS unless its OSTs are deactivated
findings.result: Without action: no write completed during the outage, one create blocked 344 s. With the dead OSTs deactivated on MDS+client: 21 writes and 180 creates ok, only the in-flight operations failed (51-57 s); 38/38 written files intact.

findings.title: Metadata is not redundant
findings.result: New directories alternate between MDT0 and MDT1; losing a head stalls the directories on its MDT (write 240 s, creates failed after 60 s). Head-1 loss also evicts clients on return (abort_recov): first 2 read-backs I/O errors.

findings.title: Rolling reboot can leave a node's IB port in INIT
findings.result: Loop 1 of 2 passed (10/10). Loop 2: Head-2's port stayed INIT about 10 min (no SM activated it); both head OpenSMs STANDBY; OpenSM runs on all 10 nodes with equal priority. Recovered by restarting OpenSM on Head-1.

findings.title: Deterministic subnet-manager layout fixes the rolling reboot
findings.result: OpenSM only on the heads (Head-1 priority 14, Head-2 13), off on the computes; reboot.yml waits for the IB port ACTIVE. Rolling reboot repeated: 3 of 3 loops passed (about 1520-1540 s each), pool HEALTHY. Small sample; cause not fully proven (why the previous master did not activate Head-2's port is unexplained).

findings.title: Graceful shutdown order was wrong
findings.result: The old shutdown.yml powered the heads off first; the computes' umount of /mnt/lustre then hung more than 6 minutes against dead servers (serial play, 7 more nodes pending). New order: clients unmount everywhere, computes power off together, then Head-2, then Head-1 (MGS + MDT0) last. Not yet run end to end.

findings.title: 6-hour soak: no errors, no drift
findings.result: 36 rounds, 8/8 nodes and 16 OSTs healthy every round, 0 I/O / dmesg / IB errors. Combined throughput plateau 23.07 +- 0.13 Gbit/s (CV 0.57%) after a 7.3% step down in rounds 1-5; first half vs second half of the plateau differs by 0.07%. About 28.5 TiB moved (estimate).
